script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A young boy, ETHAN, 8, sits on the couch, staring at his tablet. His mother, JENNY, 35, enters the room, a frown on her face.

JENNY
(looking concerned)
Ethan, you've been on that tablet all morning. Go outside and play.

ETHAN
(shrugs)
There's nothing good outside.

JENNY
(sighs)
I understand, but you need fresh air and exercise.

ETHAN
(grabbing his tablet)
I'll just take it outside.

Jenny shakes her head.

JENNY
No, Ethan. That's not what I mean. Go play in the yard, ride your bike, or play with your friends.

ETHAN
(pouting)
Fine.

Jenny ruffles his hair and leaves the room. Ethan looks down at his tablet, then reluctantly sets it aside. He stands up and opens the front door.

INT. YARD - DAY

Ethan steps outside and looks around. He sees his neighbor, MIA, 9, playing with her dollhouse in her driveway. He approaches her.

ETHAN
(calling out)
Hi, Mia.

MIA
(looking up)
Hey, Ethan. What do you want?

ETHAN
(awkwardly)
I don't know. I just wanted to talk to you.

MIA
(skeptical)
Why?

ETHAN
(sheepishly)
I don't know. I guess I'm bored.

MIA
(smiling)
Well, I have an idea. Come help me build a fort.

EXT. YARD - DAY

Ethan and Mia work together to build a fort using old boxes and blankets. They laugh and joke, and Ethan begins to feel more at ease.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Jenny is preparing dinner while Ethan does his homework at the kitchen table.

ETHAN
(grumbling)
I don't get why we have to build a fort. It's not like it's going to rain or anything.

JENNY
(looking up from the stove)
It's not just about the fort, Ethan. It's about making friends and learning to work together.

ETHAN
(rolling his eyes)
Mom, I get it.

Jenny smiles and goes back to cooking.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Ethan and Mia sit on the couch, watching a movie. Ethan looks over at Mia and smiles.

ETHAN
(whispering)
This is kind of nice.

MIA
(smiling back)
Yeah, it is.

Suddenly, the power goes out. Ethan and Mia look at each other in surprise.

MIA
(grabbing a flashlight)
Let's go check on the fort.

EXT. YARD - NIGHT

Ethan and Mia make their way to the fort, using the flashlight to guide them. They sit inside, huddled together for warmth.

ETHAN
(looking around)
This is actually kind of cool.

MIA
(smiling)
Yeah, it is.

They sit in silence for a moment, then Ethan breaks the silence.

ETHAN
You know, I've been thinking.

MIA
(raising an eyebrow)
About what?

ETHAN
(hesitantly)
About a robot. A robot that can help us build forts and do other stuff.

MIA
(laughing)
A robot? That's kind of far-fetched, Ethan.

ETHAN
(shrugs)
Maybe, but it could be really cool.

MIA
(grinning)
Well, if you want to build a robot, we can start researching and building it together.

ETHAN
(excitedly)
Really?

MIA
(nods)
Sure. Let's call it AI-Mate.

EXT. GARAGE - DAY

Ethan and Mia work together in the garage, building the framework for their AI-Mate. They research and experiment, making adjustments as they go.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jenny enters the room, carrying a tray of cookies. She sees Ethan and Mia huddled over their tablet, surrounded by wires and electronic components.

JENNY
(surprised)
Wow, you two have really been working on that robot.

MIA
(smiling)
Yeah, we've made some progress.

JENNY
(impressed)
That's impressive. Keep up the good work.

Jenny leaves the room, and Ethan and Mia continue their work, their faces filled with determination and excitement.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (LATER)

Ethan and Mia sit on the couch, watching their AI-Mate come to life for the first time. It's a simple robot, made of cardboard and wires, but it's their creation.

ETHAN
(whispering to Mia)
We did it.

MIA
(smiling)
We sure did.

They spend the rest of the night programming their AI-Mate, naming it AIDEN. And as they work, they realize that the true value of their creation isn't in its functionality, but in the friendship and teamwork that brought it to life.

FADE OUT.
